newsitem.title: USA: USF&G to redeem preferred share series.
newsitem.headline: USF&G to redeem preferred share series.

text.p: USF&G Corp said on Friday that it is calling half of an issue of series A preferred shares and it also completed two capital security offerings.
USF&G said it called 2.0 million shares or 50 percent of its outstanding $4.10 series A convertible for $50 a share. USF&G said it currently intends to call the remaining shares during 1997.

The company said it recently issued $100 million of 8.50 percent 49-year series A capital securities and $100 million of 8.47 percent 30-year series B capital securities. Both issues will be used to redeem the preferred shares and debt. Holders of the series A and series B capital securities will be entitled to receive cash distributions semi-annually, beginning June 15 and July 10, 1997, respectively, USF&G said.
